svg.title: Simulation loop
svg.desc: Simulation loop. On the left, the world at tick t: an environment state (map, objects, clock) and agents 1, 2, … n, each with its own state and memory. An arrow leads to step(world), which runs env.apply_rules(state), then for each agent a.perceive(world) and a.act(world). One LLM call per agent per tick, so the step is stochastic: each rerun is a new world. The step produces the world at tick t + 1 on the right, with the same environment and updated agents, and a dashed arrow loops back: next tick, world ← world′.
svg.text: one LLM call per agent per tick,
each rerun is a new world
